master.value: master tile index into assets/tiles/master/master.json tiles[] (atlas cell x = tiles[i].x, y = tiles[i].y); 65535 = none

tiles.value: tile id 0-255 in the map's tileset region (assets/tiles/region_<RR>/, tile t at column t % 16, row t // 16)

name: troll cave
notes: Reachable area from the listed entries by the px_to_im/prox rules; cropped to those tiles, their neighbours and a 1-tile margin. blanked_tiles cells belonged to another space or were fragments not connected to this one, and were set to tile 0.
name is the shipped name (review decision); source_name derives from the doorlist comment, place_names are what the game prints (narr.asm).
Tile ids 0-127 differ between the region 8 and 9 tilesets (terra1 / image group 1); 128-255 are shared (fmain.c:624-625).

preview.markers: magenta rings: entry landing points; cyan outlines: openable door tiles (type 15, open_list name; 0 here)
